segments.title: 第115章 全班第一
segments.content:
The Re-blossoming of Youth Chapter 115: First in the Class

Li Guohong sat in the seat at the very corner of the classroom from seven-thirty in the morning until the parent-teacher conference began at eight.

At first, he was still thinking how wonderful it would be if he could attend Xixi's conference, feeling resentful about this arrangement. But later, his perspective gradually shifted, and he suddenly realized that attending Li Luo's conference wasn't so bad after all.

For example, after he found his son's seat and sat down as Li Luo had instructed, the head teacher on the stage suddenly came down to chat with him.

Although it was just a few pleasantries, polite words thanking his son for helping the head teacher manage the class recently, feeling the gazes of the surrounding parents still made Li Guohong feel quite pleased.

Another example: because the teacher had arranged for the students to wait for their parents to arrive, a girl named Yan Zhusheng was sitting next to Li Guohong.

She was Li Luo's deskmate. The moment she saw him, she greeted him politely with "Hello, Uncle," and even took the initiative to pour him a cup of water.

Curious, Li Guohong chatted with this classmate named Yan Zhusheng for a bit and found that her relationship with his son was quite good; everything she said was praise for Li Luo.

And another example: some parents even came over to greet him simply because they heard the head teacher say he was the class president's father.

They also said that their own children often talked about the class president at home, saying how outstanding he was, how great he was during the military training, how he was usually humorous and witty, and how capable he was at critical moments.

Hearing this, Li Guohong felt his face flush on Li Luo's behalf.

He was praised so much that he almost thought he had walked into the wrong classroom. Was this really his son?

You really couldn't blame Li Guohong for this.

On one hand, Li Luo had been mischievous as a child and often caused trouble at school, and it was always him who had to clean up the boy's messes.

On the other hand, if it were a parent-teacher conference for Li Luo's good grades, it wouldn't be his turn to attend at all. Lin Xiuhong would be the one to come and receive the compliments.

So, from childhood to now, for Li Guohong, the news he received from the school about Li Luo had mostly been negative.

An instance like this, full of nothing but positive feedback, was the first damn time he had ever experienced it in his life. He was completely at a loss.

And just as Li Guohong was immersed in this dream-like atmosphere, Li Luo happened to walk into the classroom through the front door with a tall figure.

It had to be said, even wearing sunglasses and a mask, Yuan Wanqing's aura was incomparable to that of an ordinary parent.

The moment she walked into the classroom, her unique presence instantly quieted the room.

Especially for the fathers, seeing such an elegant mother at a parent-teacher conference easily made them subconsciously look over.

Even though she was hidden by sunglasses and a mask, it made people instinctively assume that the face beneath the mask must be very beautiful.

"Teacher Kong, hello." After entering the classroom, Yuan Wanqing greeted Kong Junxiang on the stage. "Thank you for taking care of Yan Zhusheng."

"You're too kind. She's usually very well-behaved and diligent. I should be the one thanking her for being the sports committee member and contributing to the class." Kong Junxiang smiled politely, then pointed towards Yan Zhusheng's seat. "Yan Zhusheng's mother, please have a seat."

Kong Junxiang was clearly aware of Yuan Wanqing's identity and didn't mind her wearing a mask.

And before greeting him, Yuan Wanqing had already taken off her sunglasses, revealing a pair of willow-leaf eyebrows and peach-blossom eyes very similar to Yan Zhusheng's.

Watching her mother walk all the way to her desk, Yan Zhusheng immediately stood up and gave her the seat.

Li Luo also took the freshly poured cup of water from Xiuxiu and placed it in front of Yuan Wanqing.

Then, Kong Junxiang on the stage said, "Alright, all the parents are here now. Students, you may leave. Our parent-teacher conference will now officially begin."

The students who had been accompanying their parents after giving up their seats immediately scattered like birds and beasts upon hearing the head teacher's words.

Yan Zhusheng glanced at her mom, then at Li Luo, pursed her lips, and also left the classroom.

Only Li Luo and Xiuxiu, as the class president and vice president, remained in the classroom to assist Kong Junxiang in conducting the conference.

"You must be Li Luo's parent, right?"

After sitting down and watching Yan Zhusheng leave the classroom, Yuan Wanqing took off her mask, turned to look at Li Guohong, and greeted him with a smile, "Thank you for how your Li Luo has taken care of our Shengsheng."

"Not at all... uh..." Li Guohong was about to offer some polite words when he saw Yuan Wanqing take off her mask, and his expression froze for a moment.

To be honest, in social media and various variety shows and interviews, Yuan Wanqing's photos were either heavily edited or she had makeup done by professional artists, so she always looked exceptionally refined and beautiful.

Today, however, Yuan Wanqing wasn't wearing heavy makeup, having only lightly concealed the blemishes on her face.

Now under thirty-five, she was still quite young among the parents. Coupled with her well-maintained skin, she looked to be in excellent condition.

But even so, her real-life appearance was certainly not as stunning as her meticulously prepared look on stage.

So when Li Guohong saw her face, he just felt a subconscious flicker of surprise, feeling that her face looked somewhat familiar.

She really looks like that Yuan Wanqing.

This Yan Zhusheng's mother really takes good care of herself.

Li Guohong lamented this in his heart, not once considering the possibility that "this is Yuan Wanqing."

He just thought they looked very similar.

And even if he had his doubts, he couldn't just ask upon first meeting. It would be rather rude if he guessed wrong.

Yuan Wanqing didn't think any of the parents would recognize her either.

After all, she had been out of the spotlight for over a decade and had only made a comeback in the last few days. The parents in the class, who were in their thirties and forties, most likely didn't pay attention to such things.

Plus, since they all addressed each other as "Li Luo's father" and "Yan Zhusheng's mother" without asking for real names, there was no chance of her identity being exposed.

Thus, the two of them exchanged a few pleasantries, got to know each other simply, and then Kong Junxiang on the stage announced the official start of the parent-teacher conference.

Xiuxiu was at the side operating the PPT, playing the pre-prepared school materials in sync with Kong Junxiang's pace.

Kong Junxiang spoke eloquently on the stage for a few minutes, giving a brief introduction to the school and the class's situation.

"Our class did very well in this midterm exam." After talking broadly for a while, Kong Junxiang finally got to the main point of the conference and began to discuss the midterm results. "In the file folders on your desks, you'll find your children's exam papers and report cards."

"You can all pick them up now and take a look."

Instantly, the sound of rustling file folders filled the classroom.

For some parents who didn't know how to open them, Li Luo went over to help them patiently.

Meanwhile, Kong Junxiang on the stage continued, "This time, two students from our class made it into the top 50 in the entire school."

"Among the top 160 in the school, we have a total of 6 students."

"The class average score ranks second among the 12 parallel classes."

"Among them, our class president, Li Luo, yes, the one at the back of the classroom, scored 27th in the entire school."

"Compared to the start-of-term exam, that's an improvement of more than three hundred places!"

In an instant, the gazes of all the parents in the class focused on Li Luo.

Zhang Xuefen was sitting in her son Wei Chun's seat. She had just opened the folder and saw Wei Chun's rank of over 300, which she felt was pretty good.

The next second, she heard this news like a bolt from the blue, and she turned her head to look at Li Luo, completely stunned.

She thought she must have misheard.

On the other side, Li Guohong was also dumbfounded. After hearing what the head teacher said, he hastily tore open the file folder and took out the report card inside.

It was only when he saw the clear ranking of 27th in the school that he confirmed the situation, his mind buzzing.

Beside him, Yuan Wanqing also paused what she was doing, subconsciously glancing sideways at the boy named Li Luo, her eyebrows slightly raised with a look of surprise.

In the entire classroom, only Li Luo stood there, calm and unfazed, silently accepting the stares from the parents.

But in his mind, he was thinking.

So this is what it feels like to be first in the class.

This must have been what Ying Chanxi felt like when she received commendations in class back then, right?

Oh, no, Ying Chanxi was probably already used to this kind of thing.

So Li Luo silently reminded himself to be low-key and humble, and to suppress the curve of his lips.

Calm down, calm down.

In the days to come, this kind of situation would only become the norm. He had to get used to it in advance.

(End of Chapter)
